title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Count contiguous subarrays whose sum equals a target using a prefix-sum hash map.

data.text: Given an array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the total number of subarrays whose sum equals `k`.
Try every subarray and sum it. O(n²) time.

data.title: Brute Force O(n²)

data.text: Track prefix sums seen so far in a map. If `prefix - k` was seen, every earlier occurrence forms a valid subarray. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Prefix HashMap O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n²) → O(n). **Space:** O(1) → O(n). The map remembers every prefix sum we have seen — if `prefix - k` appeared, we found a matching subarray.

cards.title: Prefix HashMap
cards.description: Count subarrays by past prefix sums
